props.title: Bottles designed for long days, not short seasons.
props.description: ThermoFlask builds double-wall vacuum insulated bottles that keep drinks hot for 12 hours and cold for 24, carried daily and built to last.
props.body: Every ThermoFlask bottle starts with 304 stainless steel, a BPA-free lid, and a vacuum-sealed double wall. We sample, test, and re-test each batch for insulation hours, leak resistance, and drop survival before it ships. The result: one bottle, one routine, replaced far less often.
props.caption: 800ml of 2°C water after a full workday — the photo we repeat every season.

props.headline: One leaky bag, one 500ml bottle, and a checklist that never gets shorter.
props.lead: ThermoFlask started when a commuter bag came home soaked. The fix was not a bigger bag, it was a bottle that would not leak.
props.body: The first sample ran through 14 days of commute, gym, and flight tests: flip-lid openings, carbonated pressure, and 12-hour insulation checks. The checklist from that run still ships with every new batch, and it is why the product page can state 12h hot / 24h cold with confidence.
props.note: If a claim cannot be measured on the bottle we sell, it does not go on the page.

props.headline: A short spec sheet says more than a long story.
props.description: Every number on this page comes from a measured test on the same bottle you can order.

props.headline: Three rules that keep the catalog small and the claims honest.
props.description: These principles decide what ships, what gets written, and what gets fixed.

values.title: Daily-use first
values.description: A bottle has to survive a real commute, gym bag, and desk before it earns a place in the collection.

values.title: Specs that measure
values.description: Every capacity, insulation time, and weight claim on the page comes from a tested sample, not a guess.

values.title: One-year support
values.description: If a lid seal or vacuum fails within a year of daily use, we replace it. No forms, no drama.
